name: workerd procdump (ANY first-chance C++ exception)
description: Bulletproof variant: dump on the first C++ exception of any kind (-e 1 with no filter, -n 1). Use this if the filtered version still says 'Dump count not reached'.
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $w='${WorkerdPath}'; $probe='${ProbeCapnp}'; $diag='${DiagDir}'; $dumps="$diag\dumps"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dumps | Out-Null; $procdump = Join-Path (Split-Path $w) 'procdump.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $procdump)) { Write-Error "procdump.exe not found at $procdump"; exit 2 }; if (-not (Test-Path $probe)) { Write-Error "probe capnp missing: $probe"; exit 3 }; Write-Output "procdump: $procdump"; Write-Output "dumps   : $dumps"; & $procdump -accepteula -ma -e 1 -n 1 -x $dumps $w serve $probe 2>&1 | Out-String; Write-Output '== resulting dumps =='; Get-ChildItem $dumps -File -Filter 'workerd*.dmp' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 5 FullName, Length, LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String
